profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at ZipRecruiter | Hockey nerd | Commercial sUAS Pilot
profile.summary:
My passions include developing healthy engineering cultures, discussing mundane library coding implementations, leveraging any opportunity to supercharge my team, and helping engineers grow in their careers. I like to deliver value and chew bubblegum, and I'm all out of bubblegum.

Professional IC experience in backend web development revolving around high-throughput applications ensuring scalability and reliability in cloud environments with a dash of full-stack AngularJS work. 

I regularly use Java, Kotlin, Typescript and Svelte.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: SMB - Customer Retention & Lifetime Value

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Employer/SMB - Monetization (Sept 2023 - June 2024)

Migrating legacy code to a combination of Node/TS and Golang gRPC services

Employer/SMB - Employer Profiles (June 2024 - December 2024)

Part of the team modernizing the Employer Engineering infrastructure at ZipRecruiter for internal use, enabling teams to iterate quicker on produce decisions.

Employer/SMB - Proactive Sourcing (Resume Database) Tech Lead (December 2024-Present)

Leading the team that is rethinking Zip's approach to the art of Proactive Sourcing, mainly focused on tech stability and flexibility under increasing usage and continuous improvements.

positions.title: Manager II, Engineering
positions.description:
Enterprise Apply

Responsibilities include:
Overseeing the team of 10 full-stack engineers responsible for all job applications (including internal and external) at ZipRecruiter. Additionally own all Apply data infrastructure and insights.
This includes regular 1:1s around personal and professional growth, bi-yearly performance reviews, and promotion submissions. 
Team KRs based on organizational objectives, following the OKR model.
Proliferating tech initiatives, both intra- and extra-team.
Oversight of general app health and maintenance, as well as new feature design and development.
Partnership with product to identify key features and improvements to pursue while balancing tech initiatives and maintenance/QoL improvements.
Participating in the tech interview process to help Zip identify, assess and attract key engineering talent.
Steward for the Management Book Club, a group for people managers and interested individuals to read and discuss books as they relate to people managing.

positions.title: Manager, Engineering
positions.description:
Smart Apply

Responsibilities include:
Overseeing the team of 5 engineers dedicated to the Smart Apply feature on ZipRecruiter. This includes regular 1:1s around personal and professional growth, bi-yearly performance reviews, and promotion submissions. 
Team KRs based on organizational objectives, following the OKR model.
Proliferating tech initiatives, both intra- and extra-team.
Oversight of general app health and maintenance, as well as new feature design and development.
Partnership with product to identify key features and improvements to pursue while balancing tech initiatives and maintenance/QoL improvements.
Participating in the tech interview process to help Zip identify, assess and attract key engineering talent.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Smart Apply Team
Tech Lead/interim manager:
Responsible for the health and general maintenance of an emerging system.
Contributing key features to strategic ZipRecruiter Job Seeker products utilizing Java J2EE/Groovy and GCP/AWS as we expand a novel greenfield project. On the leadership side, spend a considerable amount of time working on product guidance and direction as we expand capabilities/features to more intricate areas. Additional responsibilities include onboarding new team members and providing code review/feedback as well as mentoring junior engineers. 
Outside of team responsibilities, also part of the interview process helping to assess and level candidates for the engineering organization across all levels.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
R&D Market Intelligence
Team Leader
Strategically collecting market data via various means with Java/Groovy and GCP services in a high throughput system processing millions of records per day. Additionally was responsible for onboarding new team members to the tech stack. 
Oversaw international market data (initial acquisition and maintenance), strategic cross-team partnerships with SMB clients, and automated backend acquisition systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer - Customer Communications Team
Backend development work focused on high reliability, sustainability, and scalability in high through-put applications utilizing the Spring framework, RESTful APIs, microservices and the Google Cloud Platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Driven Development · Spring Framework · Spring Batch · Agile Methodologies · Mockito · Groovy · Git · Java · Google Cloud Platform · SQL

positions.title: PURE Math Scholar
positions.description:
I am half of the two-person team working on improving the NeuralIdeals package for SageMath as part of a 2017 Summer FAST research grant. 
Utilizing Python, we are implementing research results revolving around neural rings and specifically place cell visualization within SageMath. These results are part of ongoing work by our faculty advisor, Dr. Luis Garcia-Puente, and 3 students doing research under his tutelage. 
The job is primarily remote, with on-site meetings once per week.

positions.title: Dairy Clerk
positions.description: Daily upkeep of the dairy department requiring strategic placing of resources and time management skills in order to maximize department efficiency and increase sales while simultaneously reducing shrink.

positions.title: Executive Team Leader
positions.description: Oversaw the Logistics processes of a D-volume Target retail store. Responsibilities included daily operations of the the store as LOD/MOD as well as managing the backroom, flow, pricing, planogram, and instocks teams.

positions.title: Shift Supervisor
positions.description: Preparation of numerous food and beverage items following rigorous company standards. Manage partners in a manner as to result in the most efficient store operations possible. Extensive cash handling and MOD/LOD duties.

positions.title: Sport Clubs Intern
positions.description: I oversee all sport club activities, including recruitment, fundraising, practicing and financing. I am the employee responsible for all sport clubs and perform regular duties including equipment purchase, vehicle reservations, and assist in the general functioning of clubs, including internal issues.

positions.title: Sport Clubs Supervisor
positions.description: I oversee sport club practices and act as the main liaison for clubs during practice times. Trained in CPR, First Aid and AED use by the American Heart Association.

positions.title: Climbing Wall Supervisor
positions.description: I oversee climbing activities and belay training classes for participants. I strive to increase participation numbers by encouraging participants to test their skill limits in a controlled environment to aid in personal development.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Arlington

honors.title: Most Scholarly
honors.issuer: Issued by Association of Computing Machinery, SHSU Chapter · Apr 2017

projects.title: Malware Analysis & Defense
projects.description:
Analyzed WanaCry Ransomware and completed project report
Worked in the Windows NT API with the goal of a generalized "exe checker" utilizing VirusTotal and kernel drivers.

projects.title: Visualizations in NeuralIdeals
projects.description:
Implementation of various visualization techniques within Python-based SageMath. 
This is an extension for the currently existing 'NeuralIdeals' package, and also implements several different calculations given canonical forms.

organizations.name: The Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers
